Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at a location that has no untracked part.
    • How to do it: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Locations in the left menu, then New Location; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425642 LOCATION NEW in Name * and click Save & Close. To switch to it: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it.
  • Have a tracked part, part A, at that location whose part number, description and tags contain neither the word not nor the word tracked.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425642 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425642-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 1 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Start on that location's Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
